import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_4/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, add them here
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Transformation plan:
    # - Target schema: ['fname': string, 'count_of_obs': integer]
    # - From source, 'fname' column exists and is string type
    # - We need to count the number of observations per 'fname'
    # - So group by 'fname' and count rows per group

    result_df = combined_df.groupby('fname', as_index=False).size()
    # pandas.Series returned by size() has name 'size', rename it to 'count_of_obs'
    result_df = result_df.rename(columns={'size': 'count_of_obs'})

    # Save the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_4/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
